customization_rules.cards: Go cardless or flat rectangular. 0px or max 4px border-radius. 1px solid border. NO soft drop shadows. Use optical clarity.
customization_rules.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). High contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
customization_rules.badges: Flat background with 1px border matching the text hue (e.g., green-700 text with green-200 border).
customization_rules.tables: Dense. border-collapse. Subdued header row. Use text-sm for data rows.
customization_rules.progress_bar: Thin (h-2), completely flat, no gradients. Primary action color.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Data-heavy areas use 1px border-border/40 to separate items.
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: Row highlight in TOC with subtle translation (-translate-y-[1px]) and border color darkening.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for clinical/academic apps. Use Flat Solid surfaces instead to prevent visual refraction of data.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use Duotone or Regular weights. Crucial for scientific/academic authority.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. All normal text minimum 4.5:1.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Simple fade-ins and micro-interactions only.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='pdf-download-btn', data-testid='chapter-status-badge').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Left-Sidebar application shell with a top action bar for global controls.
Implement a KPI strip at the top of the main area: Page Estimate, Chapter Count, Figures/Tables Count, Overall Progress.
Create a modular Grid (Bento style, high density) for the main dashboard view.
The 'Table of Contents' must be a dense, scannable list or table showing Chapter Name, Author, and a Status Badge (Complete / In Development).
The 'Book Cover Preview' should be a distinct card showcasing the cover art and publication details (ISBN-ready info).

The 'Live HTML Preview' widget must simulate an A4 page (aspect ratio approx 1:1.414) in an iframe or styled div. It must strictly use Spectral (serif) for body and Manrope (sans) for headings, with a deep teal (#0F4C5C) accent color for chapter titles to match the requested book aesthetic.
Add a prominent 'Download A4 PDF' button, ideally in the top right or within the Live Preview header, using the primary high-contrast action color.
Implement the 'Phase progress tracker' as a multi-step timeline or progress bar showing the 6 implementation phases.
Do not use generic 'Vercel-look' cards. Keep borders sharp (max 4px radius), 1px solid, with a strict high-contrast monochromatic base palette.
Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react` and use Phosphor icons to maintain an authoritative, technical academic look.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
